name: relative-time
title: Dates & Times
description: One Intl-based dates & times module — formatRelative, formatDuration, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDateRange, formatTimeOfDay, formatDueLabel, groupByDay, time-zone cookie + provider — and the RelativeTime, DateTime, Duration and DueLabel components with absolute-time tooltips.

meta.whenToUse: Any date, time, duration, due label or day grouping shown in UI — pick the function per the Dates & times page's where-to-use table.
meta.whenNotToUse: API/JSON output — keep ISO strings there.
